title: Three Paths Choice
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was about to make his decision, a sigh echoed from the depths of the Tianji Sword—a frequency similar to Chen Tianming's.

text.content: The space within the Tianji Sword resembled a boundless star sea, with Chen Ji suspended within it, surrounded by countless luminous points of divination. His brow center was tightly furrowed, the Heavenly Fate Value draining like flowing water, yet not a single definite answer could be obtained. Three trajectories of destiny intertwined before his eyes, like three rivers that would never intersect, each leading to utterly different endings.

The first path's light burned the most intensely, yet it was also the coldest. Chen Ji gazed at the figure of himself within that radiance—holding the Tianji Sword, piercing into the primordial core of the Heavenly Dao's Eye. In the instant of universal destruction, his own form would gradually dissolve into the endless backlash. "Self-annihilation..." he repeated in a low voice, a bitter smile forming at the corner of his mouth. This path's conclusion was written with the characters of "sacrifice," yet it was also the most straightforward and brutal solution.

dialogue.content: If I die, what becomes of this world... Qingyao, Nian'er, and all those who placed their trust in me... what fate awaits them?

text.content: Chen Ji waved his hand, light and shadow swirling as the core imagery of the second path materialized. Merging with the Cosmic Will meant relinquishing all human emotions and memories, becoming part of an eternal existence. Immortal and undying, yet no longer "Chen Ji." He observed that fused being perched above the Heavenly Dao, gazing down at all living things with cold detachment, unable to shed even a single tear. "Is this considered victory?" he quietly questioned. Victorious against the Heavenly Dao, yet defeated by his own self.

dialogue.content: Immortality without attachments... how does it differ from a block of unfeeling stone? Throughout my cultivation, I have never sought mere survival.

text.content: The third path glowed with the faintest light, yet it drew Chen Ji's most serious gaze. Shatter the chess game, remold the Heavenly Dao—this route held no predetermined conclusion, each decision branching toward an entirely different tomorrow. It might achieve perfection, or descend into eternal damnation. "The unknown..." complex light flickered in his eyes. "This is the true gamble."

dialogue.content: (From the depths of Chen Ji's perception, the will of the Heavenly Dao's Eye surged forth like a tide) "Wretched chess piece, why do you still hesitate? No matter which path you choose, you merely traverse my chessboard."

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze turned abruptly sharp, the suppressed edge blooming in that instant. He stared directly into that void, as if piercing through endless dimensions to perceive the Heavenly Dao's Eye's true form. "Is that so?" His voice was terrifyingly calm. "Then why disturb me during my divination? Are you afraid I will think clearly, or afraid I will choose correctly?"

A brief silence descended upon the space, the oppressive will retreating quietly. Chen Ji coldly laughed—he knew it. The Heavenly Dao's Eye was not omnipotent, otherwise it would not be so wary of a prophet not yet fully matured. He redirected his gaze to the three paths of destiny, beginning a more profound divination of each path's cost and possibility.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji weighed the three paths, each leading to a different conclusion. Which do you believe he will favor?

choices.text: Destroy the Heavenly Dao's Eye, self-annihilation
choices.description: Utterly destroy the Heavenly Dao's Eye, the cost being self reduced to nothingness. This is the most noble sacrifice, yet also the most tragic conclusion.
choices.visible_cost: Lose everything, including life and existence itself
choices.visible_reward: The Heavenly Dao's Eye is completely erased, no such existence remains in this world
choices.risk_hint: Everyone you care about will lose you, the world will lose its only hope

text.content: Chen Ji stared at the first path's final outcome, the figure dissolving within the light filling his heart with bitterness. He reached out to touch that luminous phantom, his fingertips throbbing with sharp pain, as if reminding him of this choice's cost. "If this is the only way..." his voice was low but resolute.

choices.text: Merge with the Cosmic Will, attain immortality
choices.description: Merge as one with the Cosmic Will, attaining eternal existence while losing all human emotions and memories.
choices.visible_cost: Lose all human emotions, no longer "Chen Ji"
choices.visible_reward: Immortal and undying, becoming an existence that transcends all
choices.risk_hint: You will no longer remember Qingyao, Nian'er, or any of the reasons you fought for

text.content: Chen Ji looked upon himself merged with the Cosmic Will, complex emotion flickering in his eyes. It was a brand new existence, powerful yet hollow, perched above the Nine Heavens yet never smiling again. "Immortality..." he murmured, "but what meaning is there if that immortal being is no longer me?"

choices.text: Shatter the chess game, remold the Heavenly Dao
choices.description: Not following established rules, but shattering the entire chessboard to remake the Heavenly Dao laws. The path unknown, full of possibilities.
choices.visible_cost: The road ahead unknown, possibly leading to countless calamities.
choices.visible_reward: Shatter all that is predetermined, create a brand new world order.
choices.risk_hint: This is a path no one has ever walked; both success and failure remain unknown.

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze fell upon the third path, where the light was dim yet full of tension. "Unknown, eh..." A slight smile curved his lips, revealing a meaningful expression. "This is the path I should take. The Eye of Heavenly Dao thinks it controls everything, but it never knew I never intended to play by its rules."

Just as Chen Ji delved deeper into his deduction, a strange fluctuation suddenly rippled through space. A blurred figure emerged faintly in the depths of the starry sea—the silhouette... that aura... Chen Ji's heart rate abruptly accelerated. It was the figure he had been searching for desperately for years—Chen Nian! "Nian'er?" He reached out instinctively to touch it, only to grasp at empty void. The image vanished in a flash, like a fleeting phantom.

Chen Ji's fist clenched fiercely, his knuckles cracking. His sister, his close relative taken by the Holy Sect as the "Heavenly Fate Lock Key," actually appeared in his deduction at this moment. "What does this mean?" He forced himself to remain calm. "Nian'er can interfere with the Tianji Record's foresight; any image with her in it should be blurred... Could it be that she already knows I'm here?"

dialogue.content: No matter where these three paths lead, I will never abandon you. Nian'er, wait for me... This time, it's my turn to save you.

text.content: At this moment, a long, mournful sigh suddenly echoed from the depths of the Tianji Sword space. That sigh was ancient and profound, carrying an indescribable desolation, and even more, a familiar resonance—exactly matching the aura of Chen Tianming at his final moment. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply as he spun around, only to see endless void and starry sea. "Who?!"

In the starry sea, a figure slowly materialized. It was an image of an elderly, dignified male, surrounded by countless fragments of Heavenly Dao laws, his eyes holding the depth to see through all things in the world. He floated there quietly before Chen Ji, as if having waited for an incredibly long time. "You've finally come..." The voice was aged and gentle. "I've been waiting for you for a long time, heir of the Tianji Record."

dialogue.content: (The will of the Eye of Heavenly Dao suddenly surged violently) You... you still have remnant souls remaining?! Impossible! I clearly erased you completely!

text.content: That elderly figure smiled faintly, his expression carrying boundless vicissitudes and relief. "Do you think destroying my physical body could sever all of me?" His voice was calm yet dignified. "Those chosen by the Tianji Record are never coincidences. Eye of Heavenly Dao, however intricate your chess game, you've ultimately overlooked one thing—human hearts."

Chen Ji's heart pounded like war drums. Gazing at this existence before him, similar to Chen Tianming yet far more ancient, countless questions surged in his mind. "Are you..." His voice trembled slightly, "the original master of the Tianji Record? Or..." The elderly figure shook his head, interrupting him. "Who I am isn't important. What matters is—" His gaze was profound yet earnest, "You need to know the true costs of the three paths, and the existence of the fourth path."

choice.prompt: The existence of the fourth path allowed Chen Ji to see new possibilities, yet each path has its fundamental differences. How will Chen Ji come to understand these roads?

choices.text: Inquiring about the true cost of the first path.
choices.description: Completely destroying the Eye of Heavenly Dao seems simple, but can it truly be eliminated? Or is it merely the beginning of another cycle?
choices.visible_cost: Consuming a massive amount of Heavenly Fate.
choices.visible_reward: Seeing clearly the true nature of the Path of Destruction.
choices.risk_hint: The truth is often more cruel than imagination.

text.content: That elderly figure sighed softly: "Destroying the Eye of Heavenly Dao may seem decisive, but it's actually the most foolish choice. You think it's merely an individual? No, it has long merged with the foundations of this universe. The moment you destroy it, this universe will collapse."

choices.text: Inquiring about the true cost of the second path.
choices.description: Merging with the universe's will seems to offer immortality, but after merging, are you still yourself?
choices.visible_cost: Consuming a massive amount of Heavenly Fate.
choices.visible_reward: Seeing clearly the true nature of the Path of Merging.
choices.risk_hint: The cost of immortality may be more terrifying than death.

text.content: The ancient figure's expression grew grave: "The path of fusion seems to preserve your existence, but it is the deepest trap. You think you will fuse with the cosmic will as an equal? No, you will only become part of it, forever suppressed, becoming nourishment for the new 'Heavenly Eye.'"

choices.text: Probing the truth of the third path and the fourth path
choices.description: Breaking the chess game seems filled with unknowns, but if a fourth path truly exists, what would it be?
choices.visible_cost: Consuming a massive amount of Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: Seeing the key to breaking the deadlock, as well as the existence of the fourth path
choices.risk_hint: The fourth path may be more dangerous than the previous three

text.content: A flicker of appreciation appeared in the ancient figure's eyes: "You asked the right question. The path to breaking the deadlock is indeed feasible, but it requires one crucial condition—you need to find the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key,' that is, your sister Chen Nian. She is the only key to breaking the chess game, and the existence the Heavenly Eye fears most."

When Chen Ji heard the words 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key,' his heart was shaken like a turbulent sea. Nian'er... she is not merely a relative taken away by the Holy Sect, but the most crucial piece in this chess game! "Are you saying..." His voice trembled slightly, "Nian'er being taken by the Holy Sect was not by coincidence?" The ancient figure nodded, his gaze carrying profound compassion. "From the very beginning, your sister's existence was meant for today. What the Heavenly Eye fears is not you, but her—the one who can interfere with the Tianji Record's foresight."

dialogue.content: So... from beginning to end, I thought I was arranging the world in my game, when in fact I was merely acting according to Heaven's script? Nian'er being taken away was also part of this script?

text.content: The ancient figure shook his head, a flicker of approval in his eyes: "No, you are wrong. However precise the Heavenly Eye's script may be, it cannot account for the human heart. It can calculate fate, but it cannot calculate that your sister would choose to stand by your side. All these years in the Holy Sect, she has been waiting for an opportunity—the day when she could fight alongside you." Chen Ji's eyes reddened slightly, and the guilt and self-blame of many years found some solace in this moment. Nian'er... his sister whom he had searched for throughout the years, was never a chess piece to be manipulated.
Just as Chen Ji was about to make his decision, a sigh echoed from the depths of the Heavenly Sword—that was a frequency similar to Chen Tiangming's.
